title: CSCI 620 — Introduction to Big Data
subject: Networks and Cloud Computing
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of the internet protocol suite and explain how they enable reliable data transmission across networks.
Explain how TCP ensures reliable, ordered byte stream delivery and manages flow control and retransmission.
Apply data preparation, visualization, and statistical techniques to explore large datasets in diverse real-world contexts.
